title: Best Embroidery Digitizers (2026): Logos Ready for Stitching
description: How to hire an embroidery digitizer to convert logos or art into stitch files: machine formats, size, fabric, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Embroidery digitizers convert logos and artwork into stitch files that embroidery machines can sew on caps, shirts, jackets, bags and patches. Good digitizing considers fabric, size and stitch direction so the design looks clean and does not pucker. Projects go wrong when the file is in the wrong machine format, small text is unreadable, or the design was not adapted for the fabric. This guide helps you get stitch files that sew well the first time.

faq.q: Which file format do I need?
faq.a: It depends on your embroidery machine. Common formats include DST, PES and others. Ask your embroiderer which format they use.

faq.q: Can they fix problems after a test sew?
faq.a: Good digitizers adjust files after you share photos of a test sew.
